title: LED Light Bar 10/20 Inch – Combo Beam Offroad
descriptionHtml:
Light up the road and the terrain

When you drive in the dark or off-road, you need to see far and wide at the same time. Regular lights rarely cut it when it really counts.

Combo beam for the best visibility

This light bar comes in 10 and 20 inches and has a combo beam that lights up both far and wide. It runs on 12V or 24V and fits most vehicles.

Features

  • Combo beam – lights up far and wide
  • Available in 10 and 20 inches
  • Runs on 12V or 24V
  • Durable and weather-resistant
  • Great for SUVs, trucks, boats and tractors

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
